details:
Q1: Which part of the pipeline should this issue change?
Choices:
A) Clarify / plan / implement phases (issue → PR)
B) Review & autofix (reviewer panel, editor, conflict resolver, merge train)
C) Orchestrator poller (projects, waves, judges, security pass, validation)
D) Release / consumer sync (stable promotion, update_workflows, manifests)
E) None of these: describe the target component in a reply (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What problem should be fixed, or what result do you want?
Choices:
A) A specific bug or failed run: give the run, PR or issue link and the error (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or fewer tokens / API calls in a named phase
C) Faster wall-clock time in a named phase
D) Fewer Telegram alerts or less operator noise
E) Something else: describe the expected behaviour
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A named failing test, workflow run or incident no longer happens (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable change (cost, duration, alert count) above a stated threshold
C) A documentation-only change is enough
D) Close this issue as not planned; it was filed without a concrete request
